svg.aria-label: Exactly-once effects on an at-least-once queue. One transaction records the payment, the idempotency key and the job; the worker acknowledges only after its effect is committed

svg.text: Exactly-once effects on an at-least-once queue
One transaction records the payment, the idempotency key and the job; the worker acknowledges only after its effect is committed
